fusions.name: Wedge Charge
fusions.desc: Drives forward through a wide cone 5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Each target has a 40% chance to be left [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Couched Lance
fusions.desc: A lance thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 34 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rally Gallop
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 9 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Mounting Pace
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
